summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Gibo Holdings Ltd reporting a share consolidation (reverse stock split) approved at an EGM. The board implemented a 25-for-1 consolidation effective May 25, 2026, with trading on Nasdaq expected to begin on a split-adjusted basis on June 29, 2026. No fractional shares will be issued; fractional entitlements are rounded down. The consolidation affects all shareholders uniformly without altering percentage interests, except for fractional shares. The filing also covers warrant adjustments and a change in authorized share capital structure. This is a routine corporate action to meet listing requirements, not a special situation. The transfer agent, Transhare, is the exchange agent. What to watch is the potential impact on liquidity and any subsequent listing compliance.
